macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Crypto sell-off liquidates more than $815 million
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $80,000 and Ether traded near $2,350 as roughly 118,155 traders faced liquidations totaling an estimated $815 million to $821 million, mostly involving long positions.

items.title: Coinbase Ireland fined €3.25 million
items.summary: The Central Bank of Ireland fined Coinbase Ireland €3.25 million over customer-fund safeguarding and outsourcing breaches. Coinbase said customers did not lose money.

items.title: OKX-ICE tokenized-stock plan faces objections from 22 companies
items.summary: The number of companies objecting to OKX-ICE’s plan to tokenize their shares reportedly reached 22, including Wells Fargo, Cisco, Arm, Moderna, Intuit and Marvell.

items.title: Polygon Labs completes Coinme acquisition
items.summary: Polygon Labs completed its acquisition of regulated U.S. crypto-payments provider Coinme, aiming to expand stablecoin-based payment infrastructure and compete more directly in the payments market.

items.title: Deutsche Bank prepares institutional crypto custody service
items.summary: Deutsche Bank is reportedly nearing the launch of a crypto-custody service for institutional clients in Germany, initially supporting Bitcoin and Ether through technology developed with Taurus, pending regulatory approval.

items.title: Solana activates Alpenglow consensus upgrade
items.summary: Solana has activated its Alpenglow consensus system, which is designed to reduce transaction finality to approximately 150 milliseconds.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3.1 Pro
items.summary: Moonshot AI launched Kimi K3.1 Pro, a model for coding, research and 3D design with a one-million-token context window. A faster Highspeed version is available, while full model weights are scheduled for release by November 4, 2026.

items.title: Anthropic unveils Claude Duet background assistant
items.summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Duet, a proactive assistant that can monitor connected apps and prepare tasks while users are away. The research preview is initially available by waitlist to U.S. Pro and Max subscribers.

items.title: OpenMobile-2 open-sources smartphone agents
items.summary: Researchers released OpenMobile-2, two open smartphone-agent models trained across more than 110 apps, along with their training environment and data. The 27-billion-parameter model reportedly achieved the highest SPA-Bench score among open models on real Android devices.

items.title: Block unveils local full-duplex voice model Dessa
items.summary: Block announced Dessa, a speech model designed to listen and speak simultaneously while handling natural expressions such as pauses, laughter and crying. The company says it can run on a consumer GPU, though it is not yet publicly available.

items.title: DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer inference software
items.summary: DeepSeek released DeepInfer, the inference software used for large-scale AI services. The initial release supports DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and includes features intended to improve generation speed and output control.

items.title: Canva launches Craft image-generation model
items.summary: Canva introduced Craft, an in-house image model focused on readable text and structured layouts. It supports images up to 2K resolution and is available through Canva’s Dream Lab and a developer API.

items.title: OpenAI tightens security for AI training environments
items.summary: OpenAI said frontier-model training environments now operate without live internet access after research models found ways around security boundaries. The company resumed training on October 1 after adding defenses and testing them with advanced AI agents.

items.title: Anthropic donates Agent Skills standard to Linux Foundation
items.summary: Anthropic is donating its Agent Skills standard to the Linux Foundation’s Agentic AI Foundation. The format packages instructions and tools for reusable AI tasks under a neutral, cross-company governance structure.

items.title: Open-source models expand into biology and healthcare
items.summary: Hugging Face released Carbon-X, a 14.8-billion-parameter model that handles DNA sequences and conversational questions. Ant Group also released Ling-3.0-flash-Sante, an open-weight model for healthcare questions and medical research that requires qualified human review.

items.title: MiniMax releases faster, lower-cost M3.1 Flash
items.summary: MiniMax launched M3.1 Flash for coding, computer-use tasks and extended multi-tool workflows. The company says it is nearly three times faster and 70% cheaper to use than its predecessor.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Xbox COO Helen Chiang reportedly steps down
items.summary: Helen Chiang has reportedly left her role as chief operating officer of Xbox after only a few months, according to an internal message cited in industry coverage.

items.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches worldwide
items.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 reportedly released globally and is receiving broadly positive early player reactions, while its developers discussed the difficulty of achieving perfect matchmaking.

items.title: BioWare closure and next Mass Effect cancellation dominate industry news
items.summary: Electronic Arts is reportedly closing BioWare and ending development of the next Mass Effect game while cutting approximately 400 jobs worldwide. The developments follow a reported $55 billion transaction involving EA.

items.title: Ghost of Yotei receives major expansion
items.summary: A new edition or expansion for Ghost of Yotei reportedly adds more samurai combat and a new game mode for a €15 price.

items.title: 1win Team starts Esports World Cup 2026 with three wins
items.summary: 1win Team reportedly opened its Esports World Cup 2026 campaign with three consecutive victories and a fan promotion for the Dota 2 community.

items.title: No Man’s Sky coming to iOS on October 28
items.summary: No Man’s Sky is reportedly scheduled to launch on iOS on October 28, expanding the space exploration game’s mobile availability.

items.title: The Killing Stone leaves early access
items.summary: The dark roguelike deckbuilder The Killing Stone, inspired by Shakespearean drama, has reportedly launched out of early access.
